elements.note: The joint the S-05 roof plan calls out as ดูขยาย "1" at grid A-1: an RC column head capped with a 200x200x9 plate, the BS1 twin-channel beam sitting on it, and the rafter cleated on with a 100x100x9 plate.

warnings: *** THIS SHEET RESOLVES THE UNRESOLVED CROSS-REFERENCES FROM S-04 AND S-05. *** S-04 carries six circled callouts (DETAIL 1 x4 at B-2/A-2/C-3/B-3, DETAIL 2 at C-4, DETAIL 3 at B-4) and S-05 one (ดูขยาย "1" at A-1), none of which said where the enlargement lived. All four are drawn here.

DETAILS 1, 2 AND 3 ARE THE SAME JOINT FAMILY -- a C-150x75x9.0x12.5 channel welded all round to a steel plate that is bolted to RC with four Ø16 bolts drilled 0.30 m into the column. What changes is the plate and the host: DETAIL 1 lands between two RC BEAMS on a 300x200x12 plate, DETAIL 2 on an RC COLUMN on the same 300x200x12 plate, DETAIL 3 on a column with a square 200x200x12 plate on a 0.20 x 0.20 section.

NOTE THE CHANNEL SIZE CLASH BETWEEN SHEETS. The channel in DETAILS 1-3 is C-150x75x9.0x12.5 -- the S-04 terrace rafter section (24 กก./ม.). But the ขยาย "1" detail on this same sheet uses C-150x75x25x3.2 (8.27 กก./ม.) for both the rafter and BS1, matching S-05. Two different 150x75 channels are in use across the set; they differ in thickness by a factor of three. Always take the section from the sheet that details the member in question.
'ล้วงลึกลงเสายาว 0.30 ม.' on the bolt tag means the bolts are drilled and set 0.30 m INTO the RC column, not that they are 0.30 m long overall. Recorded as embedment_m rather than length.
ขยาย "1" is the only detail on the sheet with anchor bars rather than bolts: two Ø9 loops 0.15 m into the column head under a 200x200x9 base plate.
All four details are at 1:10 -- the largest scale used anywhere in the structural set.
